title: CoreBunch/Instatic: an agentic, self-hosted visual CMS
friendlyTitle: Instatic is a self-hosted visual website builder with AI-agent features
summary: Instatic is an open-source visual content-management system that produces static pages and includes users, roles, plugins, content and database features. Its agentic approach targets teams that want a self-hosted alternative to hosted visual site builders.
friendlySummary: This open-source project helps people build and manage static websites visually while keeping the system on their own server.
whyItMatters: Use it to prototype or run editable websites while keeping hosting and generated output under your control. Evaluate its young ecosystem, security model and migration path before replacing a mature production CMS.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Try it for a site where you want visual editing and more control than a hosted builder gives you. Test security and backup options before using it in production.
